title: ConditionSet/v1
description: A set of conditions (assumptions) attached to a ModelInterface: a domain restriction, a positivity/boundedness/smoothness/stationarity/independence assumption, or a custom named condition. Each condition carries a kind and a mathematical expression given either as a reference (object_id) to a MathIR/v1 object or as an inline MathIR tree (structurally validated here, allowlist-validated by srl.semantic.ir.validate_expression). Canonical JSON contract: sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8, no NaN/Infinity, trailing newline.

conditions.description: The conditions. condition_id values SHOULD be unique within the set (validated by srl.semantic at runtime).

condition_id.description: Stable logical identifier for the condition within the set.

expression.description: The mathematical content: a reference (object_id) to a MathIR/v1 object, or an inline MathIR tree (allowlist-validated at runtime).

math_ref.description: A reference (object_id) to a MathIR/v1 object.

math.description: An inline MathIR expression tree (allowlist-validated by srl.semantic.ir.validate_expression).
